name: PDNO Control Benchmark
description: Core source-code and reproducibility-metadata archive for PDNO Control Benchmark v1.1.0, by Hyojin Park and Jinhong Yang. This deposit preserves the exact source ZIP, evidence manifest, SHA-256 checksum list, and a scope/retrieval guide. The large model-checkpoint, synthetic-trajectory, raw-outcome and request-timing files are hosted separately in the matching public GitHub release: https://github.com/Jinhong-Yang/pdno-control-benchmark/releases/tag/v1.1.0 . They are not included in this Zenodo deposit. The 11 GitHub evidence ZIPs contain 1,223 payload files, including all 50 selected revision checkpoints and preserved original checkpoints. Immutable source commit: bc6de067d3be547ed01345b48625eb52bcdc0666. The manifest identifies the external evidence byte-for-byte. All 14 GitHub assets were actually downloaded and hash-verified; their extracted source/evidence passed fresh CPU-environment checks: 47 implementation tests, 12 original checkpoint cases, all 50 revision checkpoint checks, 3,812 raw-array checks, 72 interval rows, and ten byte-identical regenerated CSV summaries. This is CPU and saved-evidence reproduction, not new GPU training, control evaluation or latency replication. Revision experiments comprise reference-solver candidate comparisons, enlarged Burgers training, single-seed loss-weight sensitivity, separately generated nonnegative-initial-field heat evaluation, and candidate-count/cache timing probes.
